Title: Wrong mask for HASH_SR_NBWE

Body:
Found in
https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-u5/blob/00779e352e24435e0c7fc3b14b2416076216837b/Include/stm32u585xx.h#L6014
But the other devices are probably wrong too.
HASH_SR_NBWE has 5 bits according to the datasheet (and they are really needed since it can hold up to the value 0x11)
Corect mask is (0x**1**FUL << HASH_SR_NBWE_Pos)  or 0x00**1**F0000  instead of (0x1FUL << HASH_SR_NBWE_Pos) or 0x000F0000.

Comments:

Looks you're right. Thank you for the heads up. I'll let our development teams know in order to fix this.

With regards,

ST Internal Reference: 206641

Title: Incorrect JPEG register definitions

Body:
In stm32u5g9xx.h (and maybe in more files), there are a few incorrect definitions:

c
#define JPEG_BASE_S (AHB1PERIPH_BASE_S + 0x0A00UL)
#define JPEG_CFR_CEOCF_Pos   (4U)
#define JPEG_CFR_CHPDF_Pos   (5U)

They should be:

c
#define JPEG_BASE_S (AHB1PERIPH_BASE_S + 0x0A000UL)
#define JPEG_CFR_CEOCF_Pos   (5U)
#define JPEG_CFR_CHPDF_Pos   (6U)

Title: Wrong VREFBUF voltage scale #define

Body:
In the stm32u5xxxx.h files, the following #define does not setup correctly the VREFBUF voltage scale :
#define LL_VREFBUF_VOLTAGE_SCALE3          VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_2       /*!< Voltage reference scale 1 (VREF_OUT4) */

VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_2 should be (0x03UL<< VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_Pos) :
#define VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_2       (0x04UL<< VREFBUF_CSR_VRS_Pos)                      /*!< 0x00000030 */
